Establish or strengthen relationships with current partners, local CSOs and other stakeholders. Participate in consolidating DCA’s and NCA’s presence in Ukraine and advise on partnership, consortia, impact, and funding opportunities. Coordinate with relevant humanitarian fora, international NGOs, UN agencies, donors, national and local authorities, and other stakeholders. Support and oversee the development of strong Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning systems. Take lead on fundraising activities. Support, develop and oversee national capacity building plans, ensuring a timely delivery. A well-developed humanitarian toolbox with “can-do” experience in assessments, cash/markets programming, distributions, WASH, protection, livelihoods. Capacity to lead the transition of humanitarian livelihoods programming towards sustainable market systems approaches and increased private sector partnerships. Clear understanding of the humanitarian cluster system. Experience in a volatile and insecure context and the ability to keep a cool head under pressure. Demonstrable project development and fundraising experience. Sound understanding of holistic programming and using humanitarian assistance as a foundation for development initiatives and longer term impact. Strong analytical skills with ability to plan, coordinate and lead processes that include multiple stakeholders and interests. Fluency in written and spoken English. Fluency in Ukrainian is an advantage. We offer: 12-month contract (renewable based on funding etc). A generous remuneration package, with salary and benefits in accordance with the applicable DCA employment terms. Insurance as per industry standards. An interesting and challenging experience addressing humanitarian needs. A dynamic, flexible and respectful working environment that will give you the freedom to work and support to succeed. Everyone applying for a job with DCA must be ready to comply with our Code of Conduct, Staff Policy on Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment and our Child Safeguarding Policy.
